intent: Enforce the existing inclusive 20MiB file-import contract against the actual opened file while preserving normal links, cancellation, session ownership and previous transcript.

findings.title: Symbolic-link metadata undercounts the audio file actually read
evidence: A 20971521-byte target reports 13 bytes through its symbolic link, but Data(contentsOf:) reads the full target.
The real workspace red reaches stopped-backend admission instead of reporting its size limit.
Green rejects direct/linked oversize inputs, admits empty/exact-limit regular inputs, rejects nonregular paths and preserves session/transcript.
Three-second direct/linked native HTTP uploads each decode to three seconds; full make check and supplemental workflow exit 0.

advisory.status: not passed on baseline or current source

items: short-utterance TTS and strict two-hour M4 load
physical dictation, recording, listening and device/sleep recovery
Developer ID notarization and actual GUI upgrade permission retention

testing_gaps: File growth specifically between fstat and read was reviewed but not forced with a deterministic race harness.
Slow or remote filesystem kernel-read cancellation latency is not measured.

learnings.existing_pattern: AssetDownloader uses fstat on an opened descriptor and checks cancellation while reading.

verdict: Ready with fixes for this scoped change; original overall goal remains active
